Sandbox_LMION_GarageMaxWidth_tooltip: Maximum garage door width players may place or build. Vanilla garages observed by LMION are at most 6 tiles wide; values up to 12 are available for custom servers and maps.
Sandbox_LMION_UnlimitedGarageWidth_toolt: Removes LMION's configured garage width cap. The actual Project Zomboid engine limit is not defined by LMION.
